target.rawSql: SELECT time, to_timestamp_nanos(end_ns) AS timeend, CONCAT(kind, ' ', CAST(seconds AS VARCHAR), ' s') AS text FROM quality_intervals WHERE experiment_id IN (${experiment:sqlstring}) AND signal = '${signal}' AND policy_version = '${policy_version}' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

list.name: windows
list.query: SELECT string_agg('(''' || experiment_id || ''', ' || (extract(epoch FROM start_time)::bigint * 1000000000)::text || ', ' || (extract(epoch FROM end_time)::bigint * 1000000000)::text || ')', ', ' ORDER BY experiment_id) AS windows FROM ${pg_schema}.experiment WHERE experiment_id IN (${experiment:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql: SELECT experiment_id, start_time, end_time FROM ${pg_schema}.experiment WHERE experiment_id IN (${experiment:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time, value, value_raw FROM readings_processed WHERE experiment_id IN (${experiment:sqlstring}) AND signal = '${signal}' AND policy_version = '${policy_version}' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

WITH w(experiment_id, t0, t1) AS (VALUES ${windows:raw}) SELECT r.experiment_id, (CAST(r.time AS BIGINT) - w.t0) / 60000000000.0 AS experiment_time_min, r.value FROM readings_processed r JOIN w ON r.experiment_id = w.experiment_id WHERE r.signal = '${signal}' AND r.policy_version = '${policy_version}' AND r.verdict = 'accepted' AND CAST(r.time AS BIGINT) >= w.t0 AND CAST(r.time AS BIGINT) < w.t1 ORDER BY r.experiment_id, r.time

SELECT experiment_id, signal, kind, time AS start, seconds, points FROM quality_intervals WHERE experiment_id IN (${experiment:sqlstring}) AND policy_version = '${policy_version}' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
